scope: Fixed envelope faults and seeded body corruptions of five demos (two Q3, one QL, two RTCW MP) played by fnTech3, and both Q3 sets by retail quake3.exe 1.32. No engine code changed.

runsUtc.basis: modification times of the probe's output files

assembled.note: Commit c71aa54 added the report and the probe without this record. It was assembled afterwards from the probe's saved outputs; no game was run to assemble it.

probe.probeCfg:
set cl_allowDownload 0
set cl_motd 0
set com_introplayed 1
set timedemo 1
set fault_tick "echo FAULT_DEMO_TICK; wait 100; vstr fault_tick"
demo fault
vstr fault_tick
probe.note: The runs predate the commit. The committed probe regenerates every played input from its source demo and seed, byte for byte, and its patterns reproduce every log-derived field from the saved console logs; every variant home holds the probe.cfg above.

client.platform: Windows x86, RelWithDebInfo, RTCW and WolfET development gates on

q3-four.origin: demos/four.dm_68 shipped in Quake III Arena 1.32 baseq3/pak8.pk3, byte-identical to four.dm_66 in pak6.pk3 (2026-09-18-q3-paused-lagometer.json)

q3-fntech3.origin: fntech3-q3-probe.dm_68, recorded by fnTech3 on q3dm17 (runtime.self-q3 in 2026-09-18-rtcw-demos.json)

ql-fntech3.origin: fntech3-ql-probe.dm_91, recorded by fnTech3 on campgrounds (runtime.self-ql in 2026-09-18-rtcw-demos.json)

rtcw-mp-retail.origin: retail-mp-probe.dm_60, recorded by retail WolfMP.exe on a pure fnTech3 server on mp_beach (runtime.retail-in-pure in 2026-09-18-rtcw-demos.json)

rtcw-mp-fntech3.origin: fntech3-rtcw-mp-probe.dm_60, recorded by fnTech3 on mp_beach (runtime.self-rtcw-mp in 2026-09-18-rtcw-demos.json)

rtcw-mp-fntech3.stopNote: The run stopped 3.6 seconds into fuzz-13-009, while the map was loading (times from file modification times): that variant's console log ends there, and the probe classified nothing more and wrote no result.json. The cause was not recorded.
rtcw-mp-fntech3.rowsFrom: outcome, expectation and first error from the lines the probe printed; errors, truncatedNotices, timedemoLine and ticks recomputed from each saved console log with the probe's own patterns, which reproduces those fields in every row of the six complete runs; inputBytes and inputSha256 from the input file left in each variant's home. exitCode, forcedTermination and elapsedSeconds are written only with result.json and are absent.

earlierRun.note: Earlier the same day, with an earlier build and an earlier, uncommitted revision of the probe. That revision played in real time, not under timedemo, and let the client quit on demo completion; its rows carry completionMarker instead of timedemoLine and ticks, and it had no stalled outcome. Its inputs are the committed probe's fixed variants and seed-20260918 corruptions of the same demo, byte for byte. The probe commands were not saved.

set cl_allowDownload 0
set cl_motd 0
set com_introplayed 1
set cl_quitOnDemoCompleted 1
set nextdemo "echo FAULT_DEMO_COMPLETED"
demo fault
